title: Every Popcorn Kernel Is a Pressure Cooker
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: Every popcorn kernel is a tiny pressure cooker.
Inside is a drop of water, sealed in a hard shell.
Near one hundred eighty degrees Celsius, the pressure inside reaches about ten times the air around it.
The shell bursts, and the starch puffs into foam.
And the pop? Most likely, the steam escaping.
